QA_Issues.submitted_value: The Cardinal Sunflower Autumn Quilt Set brings a warm fall look to the bedroom with red cardinals, oversized yellow sunflowers and orange leaf accents across the quilt and matching sham artwork. Design Details Red cardinal birds sit above large sunflower artwork on an autumn leaf background. The gallery includes a bed mockup, close-up quilt stitching, matching pillow sham artwork, a bedroom view and a size/component panel. Sizes and Set Details Shown size choices include Throw 60x70, Twin 70x80, Queen 80x90 and King 91x102. The panel shows one premium quilt with two standard shams available as optional add-ons. The quilt panel presents a soft, breathable fabric surface suitable for year-round bedroom use.

QA_Issues.recheck_condition: The description exactly matches the live size selector and explains any gallery-panel mismatch.
